title: RWAIX shared definitions
description: Frozen schema release 1.0.0. Timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 with a Z suffix and second precision so lexicographic order matches time order. Amounts are base-10 integer strings in the asset's smallest unit. No implicit rounding.

timestamp.description: effectiveAt is a declared business time. recordedAt is when the reference service accepted the record. They are not interchangeable.

uint.description: Non-negative integer in smallest units, encoded as a string to avoid JSON number precision loss.

signerRef.description: Compressed SEC1 P-256 public key, prefixed with p256:.
